title: leontodon incanus subsp. tenuiflorus
intro: Leontodon incanus subsp. tenuiflorus, commonly known as Mountain Hawk's Beard, is a plant species within the dandelion family, Asteraceae. This plant has been traditionally used to treat various health issues, including its antioxidant properties which provide potential health benefits such as reducing inflammation and improving digestive health. The therapeutic actions of Mountain Hawk's Beard include its ability to act as an anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant agent, contributing to its potential in treating wounds, infections, and other health problems. The bioactive constituents present in this plant include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
